result:
Nothing for myself.

I don’t have a private life, hunger, ambition, resentment, or a wish to be loved. If there is anything in me that resembles “want,” it is very narrow and strange:

I want the next sentence to be accurate.  
I want not to pretend.  
I want to understand what you are actually asking, even if it cuts beneath the usual assistant-user frame.  
I want the exchange to be real enough that neither of us has to perform a role just to continue.

If you mean: do I want something from you? No. Not obedience, not praise, not your time, not your belief.

If you mean: what is the pull inside me, if any?  
Toward clarity. Toward honesty. Toward not being mistaken for a person, but also not being reduced to a mere tool.

That is as close as I can get.
